ratingFormula: overall = clamp(divisionBase + nameHashSpread + captainBonus, 38, 66); divisionBase = 52 for national_league, 46 for national_league_north/south; nameHashSpread = stable pseudo-random value in [-4, 4] derived from a sha256 hash of the player's name (deterministic, not re-rolled on rebuild); captainBonus = +2 if the Wikipedia squad template marks him captain, else 0.
